The Business Plot was planned by a group of transnational finance people including Morgan and DuPont, with support and encouragement from their German counterparts, in response to Franklin D. Roosevelt's New Deal plans.

b.name: Eleanor Roosevelt
claims: Eleanor Roosevelt received materials from the Borderland Sciences Research Associates claiming that UFOs were piloted by interdimensional beings.
Eleanor Roosevelt interviewed pilots who reported UFO sightings on her television programme.
On 1950-05-19, Eleanor Roosevelt wrote a letter to J. Robert Oppenheimer.

a.name: Jerome Clark
claims: Jerome Clark related that a young woman acquaintance, unaware of his views on UFOs, told him she dreamed of a little man stepping out of a craft, weeping and pleading with her to let him go, saying she had created him and he could not exist without her.

Jerome Clark holds the view, contrary to Jacques Vallee's hypothesis that contact between human percipients and the UFO phenomenon occurs under conditions controlled by the phenomenon, that instead the percipient controls the conditions.
Jacques Vallee has verified observations made previously by Jerome Clark, Donald Hanlon, Gordon Creighton, and John Keel, though he does not accept all of their conclusions.

b.name: Andy Clark
claims: Andy Clark wrote that cognitive systems may include both non-neural parts of the body and the beyond-the-body environment.

Andy Clark, in his research into extended cognition, has observed that the assumption that cognition is brain-bound, occurring only within the skull, is wrong, and that cognition occurs within a network that extends into the environment.
Andy Clark challenges the conventional assumption that what happens in the mind originates there, arguing that cognition is not bounded by the skull.

a.name: Lúcia (Fatima seer)
claims: Archbishop Tarcisio Bertone asked Sister Lúcia in April 2000 why she stated the Third Secret should be published after 1960, but he does not understand her answer.
In the spring of 1916, Lúcia, Francisco Marto, and Jacinta Marto were watching their herds on the eastern slope of the Loca do Cabeço mountain when a first apparition of an angel of peace occurred.
Lúcia asked the Lady during the Fifth apparition of Our Lady of Fatima (1917-09-13) to cure some sick people and heal a deaf-mute person.

b.name: Conchita (Garabandal seer)
claims: The Garabandal seer Conchita married an American and moved to New York.
Conchita said the Virgin told her there would actually be four more popes, but she does not count one, without saying why, only that one would reign for a very short period.
When Pope John XXIII died, the Garabandal seer Conchita told her mother there would be three more popes.

b.name: Vicka (Medjugorje seer)
claims: On the day after 1981-06-24, the two girls returned to the hill near Medjugorje accompanied by sixteen-year-old Vicka and Marjia, and by nine-year-old Jakov and sixteen-year-old Ivan.
The Madonna gave Ivanka Ivankovic and Mirjana Dragicevic ten secrets each, after which she appeared to them only once a year, while the other four Medjugorje seers continued to see daily apparitions.

Three flashes of lightning announced the arrival of the Virgin at Medjugorje, and Vicka said to the crowd, some of whom had not believed the children, "Now, then, do you see we were telling the truth?"

claims: Vestine, the oldest of the Kibeho seers, was a Muslim.
Michael Hesemann considers Vestine's account of travelling outside the earth to a huge different universe similar to accounts described by people who claim to have been abducted by aliens.

Vestine, the Muslim Kibeho seer, fell into a trance that lasted from Good Friday to Easter Monday in 1983, during which she said she travelled to a different place outside the earth in the company of the Mother of God and visited a huge universe different from ours.

a.name: Jacinta Marto
claims: After a journey of about an hour and a half, Artur Santos brought the three children to his house in Ourém, locked them in a room, and told them he would only release them once they told him the secret.

Father Fuentes reported that Sister Lúcia told him the Most Holy Virgin had told her, Francisco Marto, and Jacinta Marto that many nations would vanish from the face of the earth, and that Russia would be the instrument of punishment if the world did not convert that nation.

In the autumn of 1919, Jacinta Marto told Lúcia (Fatima seer) that the Madonna had told her she would be taken to a hospital in Lisbon, that she would not see Lúcia or her parents again, that she would die alone after much suffering, but that she should not be afraid because the Madonna would come herself to take her to heaven.

b.name: Francisco Marto
claims: Father Ferreira listened to the children's account of the Fatima apparitions in disbelief and was annoyed that there were details they would not or could not explain.
The hamlet of Aljustrel, where Lúcia, Jacinta Marto, and Francisco Marto lived, was part of the village of Fatima.

During the first apparition of Our Lady of Fatima, the Lady asked Lúcia if she was prepared to offer herself to God and accept all sufferings He would send to help make up for the sins of the world, and Lúcia answered on behalf of all three children that they were ready.

b.name: Manuel Pedro Marto
claims: Manuel Pedro Marto recalled that on 1917-10-13 the crowd at the Cova da Iria could look directly at the sun without being blinded as it flickered and threw beams of light in different colours.
Manuel Pedro Marto recalled that the sun appeared to tear itself from the heavens and rush toward the crowd at the Cova da Iria on 1917-10-13, which he described as a frightening moment.

Manuel Pedro Marto recalled that the carriage carrying the children suddenly changed direction on the main road and the driver whipped the horse into a gallop, which he considered a carefully organised abduction.

b.name: Olimpia Marto
claims: Jacinta Marto told her mother that she was thinking of the Saviour and the Mother of God, of sinners, and about a coming war in which many people would die, many houses would be destroyed, and many priests would be killed, and that the war would not happen if people stopped insulting and hurting God.

A year after the Fatima apparitions, in either October or December of 1918, Jacinta Marto, Francisco Marto, and their mother fell ill with the Spanish flu, which was raging through Europe at the time.
Jacinta Marto could not keep her promise of secrecy and told her mother, Olimpia Marto, that she had seen Our Dear Lady at the Cova soon after arriving home.

a.name: Maria Rosa dos Santos
claims: Olimpia Marto began telling everyone in the village about the vision the morning after Jacinta Marto's disclosure, and the rumours reached Maria Rosa dos Santos, who questioned her daughter Lúcia.

After smelling the branch from Portugal, Valinhos, Maria Rosa dos Santos's scepticism toward the Fatima apparitions changed completely, and she later defended Lúcia when others teased her about the visions.
Maria Rosa dos Santos smelled the branch that the children brought back from Portugal, Valinhos and described it as having a fine, unidentifiable perfume, not smelling of spice or roses.

b.name: Artur Santos
claims: After a journey of about an hour and a half, Artur Santos brought the three children to his house in Ourém, locked them in a room, and told them he would only release them once they told him the secret.
Artur Santos, administrator of the province of Vila Nova de Ourém, was the bitterest enemy of the Fatima apparitions.
An emergency meeting was held at the Ourém town hall, at which Administrator Artur Santos decided to ask for military help from Santarém.

claims: The Fatima events started with three children, nine-year-old Lucia Santos and her cousins Jacinta Marto and Francisco Marto, who saw an angel in the spring of 1917.
The Fatima apparition first appeared to the children in an oval of bright light and instructed them to return to the same place every month.
The experience of the shining youth left the Fatima children physically enervated for hours.

a.name: Almeida Garrett
claims: Almeida Garrett observed that the surrounding atmosphere and objects appeared to take on the colour of amethysts (purple) while he watched the sun during the 1917-10-13 phenomenon, and he feared his retina had been damaged.
Almeida Garrett observed that the landscape and people around him at the Cova da Iria appeared yellow, as if suffering from jaundice, during a later stage of the 1917-10-13 solar phenomenon.

Almeida Garrett, professor at the University of Coimbra, observed a slender bluish column of smoke rising about 1.8 metres above the children's heads at the Cova da Iria around 1:30 PM on 1917-10-13, which vanished and reappeared two more times.

b.name: José Maria de Almeida Garrett
claims: José Maria de Almeida Garrett observed that during the solar phenomenon at Fatima, everything he looked at, from nearby objects to the horizon, took on an amethyst colour.

José Maria de Almeida Garrett observed the multitude at Fatima turn away from the apparition spot to look at the sun, which appeared as a very clear disc with a sharp edge that could be stared at without hurting the eyes.

José Maria de Almeida Garrett observed a thin, fine, bluish column of smoke rise at the spot where the Fatima children stood, extending up to approximately two metres above their heads before evaporating, lasting a few seconds.

a.name: Inacio Laurenco Pereira
claims: Inacio Laurenco Pereira, a nine-year-old schoolboy at the time, recalled that a whole school of children approximately 20 kilometres from the Cova da Iria was surprised by the solar phenomenon on 1917-10-13.
Inacio Laurenco Pereira recalled that after about ten minutes the sun returned to its normal appearance and the crowd realised the danger had passed and began rejoicing.

Inacio Laurenco Pereira recalled that during the 1917-10-13 phenomenon he saw the sun looking like a rotating ball of snow that then appeared to fall toward the earth in a zigzag path, and that the panicked crowd expected the end of the world.

b.name: Cicilio Higinio Pereira
claims: On the evening of 1976-08-09, Cicilio Higinio Pereira was walking home with friends in Brazil when they saw a light in the sky that came closer and appeared to follow them.
During the 1976 encounter, Cicilio Higinio Pereira saw three men, three to four feet tall, inside the translucent object.

During the 1976 encounter, Cicilio Higinio Pereira found himself pinned almost beneath a strange flying machine, close enough to touch it, and felt a cold wind, heard a faint humming sound, and smelled sulfur.

a.name: José Alves Correira da Silva
claims: Bishop da Silva wanted to send the Third Secret to Rome, but the Vatican instructed him to keep the envelope at Leiria for the present.

The bishop of Leiria's secretary urged him to open the sealed envelope containing the Third Secret so it could be photocopied, but the bishop refused, saying it was a secret and he did not want to read it.
Early in 1957 the Holy Office asked the bishop of Leiria for photocopies of everything written by Sister Lúcia, including the sealed Third Secret.

b.name: Serafim da Silva
claims: When the Portuguese bishops visited Italy, Rome in November 1999, John Paul II bid them farewell with the words "Arrivederci a Fatima" ("See you in Fatima").
On 2000-04-27, Tarcisio Bertone and Serafim da Silva, bishop of Portugal, Leiria and Fatima, arrived at the Carmelite convent in Portugal, Coimbra, Carmelite convent.
On 1999-11-26, Serafim da Silva, bishop of Portugal, Leiria and Fatima, told the press that John Paul II had said "Arrivederci a Fatima" to the visiting Portuguese bishops in November 1999.

b.name: Valquira Silva
claims: Valquira Silva described the Varginha creature as having what looked like a set of veins bulging out of the skin on its shoulders and neck, along with the three bumps on its head.

The 1996 Varginha incident began with the sighting of a strange humanoid creature by three young women, Liliane Fatima Silva, her sister Valquira Silva, and their friend Katia Xavier, who saw a small creature slumped against a wall while walking along a road on the outskirts of Varginha.
Roger Leir interviewed Valquira Silva, who described seeing a short, crouching, motionless creature that was horrible looking, brown in colour, with oily skin and a large head.

claims: Bill Chalker notes that the circular mark and lesions found on Joao Valerio da Silva recall elements of Peter Khoury's 1992 experience and Credo Mutwa's encounter in the late 1950s.
Joao Valerio da Silva of Botucatu, Brazil, apparently lost consciousness as an attractive naked brown-haired and dark-skinned woman touched him during his 1982 abduction.
Dr. Luciano Stancka e Silva conducted a follow-up forensic medical examination of Joao Valerio da Silva, finding a circular mark on his breast with unusual lesions and slight lesions on his penis.

a.name: Cerejeira (Cardinal)
claims: Cardinal Cerejeira, the patriarch of Lisbon, said that Fatima had not yet revealed all its secrets, but that what it had already done for Portugal was a sign of what it would do for the rest of the world, and called what had happened over the previous twenty-five years a miracle attributable to the Virgin Mary.
Cardinal Cerejeira concluded his 1942-10-13 speech by saying the visions of Fatima marked the beginning of a new era.
On 1942-10-13, a mass was celebrated at the end of the jubilee festival during which Portugal was consecrated anew to the worship of Mary by the cardinal of Lisbon and the bishops.

b.name: Bea (Cardinal)
claims: At the "Fatima 2000" Conference in November 1995, Dr. Malachi Martin, former secretary of Cardinal Bea, recalled that the cardinal was shaken and annoyed that Pope John XXIII would not publish the Third Secret.
Cardinal Bea was very annoyed that Pope John XXIII wanted to hide the contents of the Third Secret of Fatima.
Malachi Martin was a former secretary of Cardinal Bea.

Cardinal Oddi reported that Pope John Paul II replied he had done everything he could for Fatima and did not consider it necessary to intervene further, since the Third Secret was no longer a secret because it had already been revealed many times.
Giorgio Bongiovanni requested that Cardinal Oddi ask Pope John Paul II about the Third Secret of Fatima during an official breakfast meeting scheduled for 1991-11-05.

Malachi Martin was a former secretary of Cardinal Bea.
Dr. Malachi Martin was later told the contents of the Third Secret by Pope John XXIII.

James Clerk Maxwell had never believed in a material aether himself, but instead assumed a hyperspatial aether simultaneously connecting everything in the universe.

b.name: Robert Maxwell
claims: Robert Maxwell sold the Prosecutor's Management Information System (PROMIS) software to Sandia National Laboratories, according to Jason Samosa.
Robert Maxwell went on to set up scientific peer review.
Robert Maxwell is Ghislaine Maxwell's father.

a.name: Maria of Agreda
claims: Sister Maria of Agreda was a cloistered Spanish nun who lived in the seventeenth century.
Witnesses reported that Theresa of Avila, Joseph of Cupertino, and Maria of Agreda all appeared to be dead when they were levitating.
Sister Maria of Agreda noted that her bilocation travels would not have happened without the assistance of angels or angelic beings.

b.name: Mary of Agreda
claims: While Mary of Agreda was levitating, other nuns could blow on her and move her about like a helium balloon, and they took her out into the convent courtyard where people paid to come in and blow her around.
Mary of Agreda, a nun in a convent, levitated and was not conscious while doing so.
Mary of Agreda bilocated across the ocean to New Mexico.

a.name: Foster Bradshaw
claims: During his 1958-09-10 out-of-body experience, Robert Monroe encountered Foster Bradshaw and Mrs. Bradshaw outside their house, with Dr. Bradshaw dressed in a light overcoat and hat and Mrs. Bradshaw in a dark coat, walking toward a smaller building resembling a garage.
On the afternoon of 1958-09-10, Robert Monroe had an out-of-body experience in which he intended to visit Foster Bradshaw and his wife, whom he knew to be ill in bed with a cold.
Robert Monroe confided his vibration experiences to a well-known psychologist and friend, Foster Bradshaw, rather than telling his wife and children.

b.name: Mrs. Bradshaw
claims: Mrs. Bradshaw confirmed she had been wearing black slacks and a red sweater covered with a black car coat, and that Foster Bradshaw had been wearing a light hat and light-coloured topcoat, matching what Robert Monroe observed during his out-of-body visit on 1958-09-10.

During his 1958-09-10 out-of-body experience, Robert Monroe encountered Foster Bradshaw and Mrs. Bradshaw outside their house, with Dr. Bradshaw dressed in a light overcoat and hat and Mrs. Bradshaw in a dark coat, walking toward a smaller building resembling a garage.
Foster Bradshaw and his wife lived in a house approximately eight kilometres from Robert Monroe's office, up a hill.

a.name: Rey Hernandez
claims: Rey Hernandez believes he was given a mandate by the beings who had been interacting with him.
Mary Rodwell agreed to help Rey Hernandez and came up with the acronym FREE, for the Foundation for Research into Extraterrestrial Encounters.
Rey Hernandez's dataset included over three thousand reports from people who claimed to have had UFO-related experiences.

b.name: Dulce Hernandez
claims: Dulce Hernandez believed that the encounter portrayed in the Hangar 1 episode had actually been an angelic encounter.
Dulce Hernandez claimed to have seen three eight-foot-tall, human-looking beings dressed in white monks' robes floating in front of her while visiting Mexico.

During the March 2012 plasma-being encounter at the Hernandez home, Dulce Hernandez saw a metallic object shaped like an upside-down U floating approximately 1.2 metres off the ground and 0.3 metres from the wall, with two ring lights in the centre.

a.name: Kary Mullis
claims: Kary Mullis is credited with the initial concept that led to the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) technique.
Kary Mullis is an American biochemist.
Bill Chalker made Kary Mullis aware of the DNA testing work on Peter Khoury's hair samples during an interview about Mullis's own alien abduction story.

b.name: Louise Mullis
claims: Kary Mullis's daughter, Louise Mullis, once disappeared for about three hours after wandering down the same hill near the Anderson Valley cabin.

Kary Mullis had told no one of his own 1985 encounter until his daughter Louise Mullis called to tell him of her own strange experience, after which she advised him to buy Whitley Strieber's book Communion.
Louise Mullis reappeared on the same stretch of road from which she had disappeared, and her fiance was about to call the local sheriff before she returned.

a.name: Agnew Bahnson
claims: Robert Monroe did not attempt to visit Agnew Bahnson out-of-body for several months after Bahnson's death, presuming Bahnson needed rest.
Agnew Bahnson died a couple of years after writing The Stars Are Too High in a plane crash.
Agnew Bahnson funded the top theoretical physicists of his time, including Thomas Townsend Brown, who was working on anti-gravity experiments.

b.name: Mrs. Bahnson
claims: That evening, Robert Monroe visited Agnew Bahnson and his wife at their home in connection with his out-of-body experience earlier that morning of 1959-03-05.
During the visit toward Agnew Bahnson's house, Robert Monroe's mind misinterpreted Mrs. Bahnson's motion of handing out the morning mail as "dealing cards."

claims: Ron Levin, Gilbert Levin's son, is a physicist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
Gilbert Levin has always insisted that his Labeled Release Experiment instrument's results on Mars were positive for life, and not the result of a mere chemical interaction.
NASA's Viking Lander images showed sharp shadows, which would not be present or would appear fuzzy due to atmospheric scattering if there were as much red dust in the atmosphere as NASA claimed.

b.name: Ron Levin
claims: According to Barry DiGregorio's book, James S. Martin, Jr. asked TRW engineer Ron Gilje to follow Ron Levin around to every colour monitor and change it back to the red landscape.
According to Barry DiGregorio's book, Gilbert Levin remarked to Patricia Straat and his son Ron Levin that the first colour image from Mars looked like Arizona.
In the summer of 1976, when Viking landed on 1976-07-20, Ron Levin was a newly graduated high school student assisting his father, Gilbert Levin, at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

a.name: Allen Dulles
claims: Ross Coulthart considers Allen Dulles and James Jesus Angleton to have done totally illegal things while running the Central Intelligence Agency, including misleading presidents and withholding information from elected authorities.
The Office of Strategic Services was run by William Donovan, together with Allen Dulles; Donovan was also a Wall Street lawyer.
Some congressional committees have been extremely dissatisfied with Allen Dulles's performance in relation to the Warren Commission.

b.name: Nelson Dulles
claims: Nelson Dulles was required to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) as part of the remote-viewing project he was recruited into.
Nelson Dulles was recruited via a vague and cryptic post on Facebook in one of his memory-athlete groups, seeking memory athletes with free time to earn extra money.
Nelson Dulles is a five-time US memory champion.

a.name: UAP Gerb
claims: UAP Gerb is a UAP researcher, investigator and podcast host.

UAP Gerb considers that legal interrogatives are likely leading to a domino effect of discovering other Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) records and materials held by other private and semi-private companies.

UAP Gerb considers that legal interrogatives sent to the MITRE Corporation, MIT Lincoln Laboratory, and cabinet-level agencies and services are more effective in pursuit of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) disclosure than the released document files and videos.

b.name: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) Gerb
claims: Donald Kerr held a vice-president or director role connected with the MITRE Corporation and with EG&G special projects.
UAP Gerb considers that the United States may have reached the ocean seabed for reconnaissance purposes before Russia did, making much of the oceans denied territory to Russia.

UAP Gerb considers that Steven Greer has on several occasions collected and released testimony illegally from people who approached him under the protections of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, and regards this as both highly unethical and wrong.

a.name: Alonzo McDonald
claims: Jason Samosa doubts that Alonzo McDonald's consulting background alone would explain an invitation into a highly sensitive programme exploring the relationship between UFOs and the occult.
Alonzo McDonald was chief executive of the consulting firm McKinsey & Company.
Alonzo McDonald was the staff director for Jimmy Carter.

b.name: Bill McDonald
claims: Bill McDonald called the triangular craft he depicted the XF-131 Super Sentinel.
Bill McDonald designed many craft depictions, including depictions relating to the Roswell case.
The artwork for the triangular craft in The X-Files was commissioned from forensic artist Bill McDonald.
